calls.statement:
SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS member_net_sales,
  ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount), 2) AS total_web_net_sales,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(f.net_amount), 1) AS member_share_pct
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN fact_web_order wo ON f.receipt_id = wo.web_order_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', wo.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 35 AND 47
  AND wo.status <> 'cancelled'
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) - 
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NOT NULL AND r.return_line_id IS NOT NULL THEN r.refund_net ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS member_net_sales,
  ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0), 2) AS total_web_net_sales,
  ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) - 
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NOT NULL AND r.return_line_id IS NOT NULL THEN r.refund_net ELSE 0 END), 0)) / 
        (SUM(f.net_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0)), 1) AS member_share_pct
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN fact_web_order wo ON f.receipt_id = wo.web_order_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', wo.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 35 AND 47
  AND wo.status <> 'cancelled'
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period
